rules: Field holdout is always isolated and never remapped into train/validation/test.
Recognized upstream train/validation/test semantics are preserved when present.
Unpartitioned groups use deterministic SHA-256 group hashing with the frozen seed.
All assets sharing recording_group_id receive exactly one ECHO split.
Exact or registered near-duplicate content may not cross protected split boundaries.
Changing seed, ratios, original split mapping or grouping semantics creates a new split-policy version.
